rationale: K=3 maximizes the normalized elbow strength among eligible K values [2, 3]. Eligibility requires every cluster >=0.5% of the sample, silhouette >=0.25 and initialization stability ARI >=0.80. K=2 has the highest silhouette; silhouette alone does not determine this choice. Selected silhouette 0.336, smallest cluster 11.58%, stability ARI 1.000.
caveat: A practical broad-pattern resolution, not a proven unique optimum. Means and rare-cluster sensitivity are reported for review.
